3154810_ea1038a9.text: neuronal progenitor (type-2) cells receive active direct neural inputs from the hippocampal circuitry

3154810_4943030e.text: This input was GABAergic but not glutamatergic.

3154810_0066a71c.text: The GABAergic inputs depolarized type-2 cells because of their elevated [Cl(-)](i).

3154810_8060fafa.text: This excitation initiated an increase of [Ca(2+)](i) and the expression of NeuroD.

3154810_fd0894d7.text: GABAergic inputs to hippocampal progenitor cells promote activity-dependent neuronal differentiation.
